name: Context Compiler (deterministic task -> versioned token-budgeted context packet)
purpose: The Collective Agent's context-compilation centerpiece (D-0080 directive Priority 4 / section 8; arch position 40). A DETERMINISTIC, CPU-only, stdlib-only Python worker (context_compiler.py) behind a thin PowerShell entrypoint that turns a task descriptor into a versioned, token-budgeted lifeorch.context_packet/0.1 artifact: normalize the task into a deterministic query set (8.1); retrieve a broad candidate set across record_kinds via a DEFINED retriever seam (8.2); deterministically rerank + diversify -- direct relevance (retriever rank/coverage), authority_level, freshness/currentness (DEMOTE stale per MEMORY_CONTRACT s5), namespace/component match, record_kind priority for the task_type, content_hash dedup + a source-diversity cap so N near-duplicate chunks do not crowd out distinct required evidence (8.3); fill a configurable token budget with EXACT per-section + total accounting and explicit truncation detection using a fixed heuristic token-count function -- ceil(chars/4), NO tokenizer, NO model (8.4/16.3); and emit the packet with the immutable original goal, the normalized task, authoritative-state refs, constraints + permissions, relevant source EXCERPTS WITH FULL PROVENANCE (record_id/record_version_id, source_path, content_hash, span{start,end}+span_label, currentness, authority_level -- reading the cited span reproduces the text, validated against chunk_content_hash), candidate skill REFS (the skill-card #41 lane owns card CONTENT), relevant procedure/failure/similar-episode refs by record_kind, open questions, the required completion contract, token-budget accounting, an OMITTED-CONTEXT summary (what was retrieved-but-dropped + why + an expand hint), escalation conditions, a DETERMINISTIC content-hash packet_id, and retrieval provenance (query set, corpus_version/index_snapshot, embedding_space_id). It also exposes a deterministic adaptive-expansion seam `expand` (8.5) -- given a packet + an expansion request (raw_source | more_evidence | related_symbol | failure_record | tool_contract | prior_episode) it returns bounded additional evidence WITH provenance (NOT a live agent loop) -- and packet-evaluation hooks / context-quality signals (8.6) recording which records were retrieved, why (feature points), rank, and included-or-omitted, so retrieval.eval #37 0.2 can score required-source coverage / provenance validity / packet tokens / irrelevant-context ratio. It is the CONSUMER of the FROZEN MEMORY_CONTRACT retriever-0.2 hit shape (s3) + s5 staleness enum + s1 provenance envelope, and the PRODUCER of context packets consumed by #37 eval and a fresh 9B at the orchestrator fold (D-0077). The RETRIEVER is INJECTED, never called from the deterministic worker: off-machine the entrypoint injects deterministic mock 0.2 hits from a fixture; -Live it runs the real artifact.search #36 `search` op (normalize -> per-query search -> compile). Non-goals (NOT built): real embeddings / vector search (consume retriever 0.2 as-is; the vector channel may be null); the retriever or catalog DB (#36 owns it -- consume via the seam); the skill-CARD content/format (#41); the MEASURED reranker + eval metrics (#37); running the 9B or ANY model (deterministic; the 9B consumes the packet at the fold); episode RECORDING (#39); skill routing / plan validation (Priority 7); UI; web search. Deterministic -> determinism=deterministic, confidence=null, empty model_provenance; the context_packet.json artifact is byte-identical on re-run (canonical JSON + a content-derived packet_id).

invocation.args_spec: Named params: -Op compile|normalize|expand (default compile); -Retriever mock|artifact_search (default mock); -CaseFile <path> (mock: a JSON case {task, retrieval_batches, source_texts, retrieval_meta, config?}); -Task <path|json> (the task descriptor for normalize / real-retriever compile); -DbPath <#36 catalog> + -RepoRoot <repo root> (-Live: the real retriever seam + span-text resolution); -K <int, default 20> (per-query candidate K); -Request <path|json> + -PacketFile <path> (expand); -ArtifactSearchEntry <path to #36 Invoke-ArtifactSearch.ps1> (default ..\36-artifact-search\Invoke-ArtifactSearch.ps1); -PythonPath <python>; -PwshPath <pwsh for launching #36>; -WorkerPath <context_compiler.py>. OR the generic -InputsJson '<json case>' (same shape as a CaseFile). Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.

inputs.name: retriever
inputs.description: mock (deterministic fixture 0.2 hits, off-machine) | artifact_search (the real #36 search op, -Live).

inputs.name: task
inputs.description: the task descriptor {original_goal (IMMUTABLE, preserved verbatim), request_text, namespace/project_id?, task_type?, time_horizon?, authority?, requested_side_effects?, relevant_paths?, relevant_entities?, constraints?, open_questions?, completion_contract?, success_criteria?, escalation_conditions?, config?}.

inputs.name: retrieval_batches
inputs.description: mock: per-query batches [{query_index, query, hits:[<retriever-0.2 hit>...]}]. The injected candidate pool.

inputs.name: candidates
inputs.description: mock: a flat list of retriever-0.2 hits (treated as query_index 0) -- alternative to retrieval_batches.

inputs.name: source_texts
inputs.description: mock: {source_path: full_text} used to resolve + reproduce excerpt spans off-machine.

inputs.name: repo_root
inputs.description: -Live: resolve repo-relative source_path -> disk to read + reproduce the cited byte span.

inputs.name: retrieval_meta
inputs.description: provenance carried into the packet {retriever, retriever_version, corpus_version, index_snapshot, embedding_space_id, fusion_algo, fusion_version}.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: overrides {token_budget, per_source_cap, max_excerpts, per_excerpt_overhead_tokens, primary_terms_cap, salient_terms_cap, literals_cap, paths_cap, max_queries, candidate_k, expand_max_tokens}.

inputs.name: packet
inputs.description: expand: the compiled context packet (or -PacketFile) providing excerpt provenance as expansion context.

inputs.name: expansion_candidates
inputs.description: expand: an injected pool of retriever-0.2 hits to expand from (real #36 or fixture).

outputs.description: envelope.result = { op, retriever, result:<op payload>, worker, runtime_ms }. compile -> { packet:<lifeorch.context_packet/0.1>, packet_id, metrics{candidate_count, excerpt_count, omitted_count, packet_tokens, budget, distinct_source_count, distinct_kind_count, provenance_reproduced_count, provenance_reproduced_all, dropped_duplicate, dropped_diversity, dropped_budget, dropped_deleted}, query_set[], config } + a byte-identical context_packet.json artifact. The packet carries: packet_id (cpkt_+sha256(body)[:32]), original_goal, normalized_task, task_type, time_horizon, namespace, constraints, permissions, current_state_refs[], excerpts[{excerpt_id, record_id, record_version_id, record_kind, source_path, content_hash, chunk_content_hash, source_version_id, span{start,end}, span_label, section_path, heading, chunk_type, currentness, authority_level, text, token_estimate, provenance{text_source, reproduced, checked_against, span_sha256}, selection{rank_in_pool, composite_score, feature_points, matched_queries, best_query_rank, fused_score_micros}}], candidate_skills[], relevant_procedures[], relevant_failures[], similar_episodes[], open_questions[], completion_contract, escalation_conditions[], token_budget{token_fn, budget, used, remaining, per_excerpt_overhead_tokens, excerpt_body_tokens, overhead_tokens, excerpt_count, truncated, budget_exhausted, omitted_count, per_source_cap, max_excerpts}, omitted_context[{record_version_id, record_kind, source_path, currentness, rank_in_pool, composite_score, reason, expand_hint?}], retrieval_provenance{retriever, retriever_version, corpus_version, index_snapshot, embedding_space_id, fusion_algo, fusion_version, query_set[], per_query_hit_counts, candidate_count}, evaluation_hooks{retrieved[{...feature_points, included, omit_reason}], packet_metrics}, expansion_affordances. normalize -> { normalized_task, original_goal, task_type, time_horizon, namespace, salient_terms[], literals[], query_set[{query_index, query, mode, purpose, filters, k}], exclude_stale, config }. expand -> { expansion:<lifeorch.context_expansion/0.1>{ expansion_id, packet_id, request, evidence[{record_id, record_version_id, record_kind, source_path, content_hash, span, span_label, currentness, authority_level, text, token_estimate, provenance, truncated}], evidence_count, token_estimate, budget_tokens, bounded, truncated } } + a context_expansion.json artifact.
